title: Details unveiled for reimagination of St. Lawrence Centre in Toronto
excerpt: Last year, CreateTO and TO Live announced that a team led by Hariri Pontarini Architects was the winner of the St. Lawrence Centre for the Arts (STLC) Design Competition.

title: Toronto's St. Lawrence Centre for the Arts could get a stunning new redesign
excerpt: A group led by Toronto architects has won an international design competition to remake a performing arts centre downtown.
